properties.name: language

properties.name: language

properties.name: cardTitle

properties.name: segmentsCsv

properties.name: colorMode

properties.name: customColorsCsv
properties.label: Custom colors (hex CSV, for 'custom' mode)
properties.description: Comma-separated hex colors, one per segment. Shorter lists cycle. Ignored unless colorMode = custom.

properties.name: singleColor

components.description: Timeline d'activité agrégée affichant Tasks, Events, emails, SMS/Web, appels, sessions de messaging, chats, Orders, Cases, Opportunities, Quotes, Contracts, Visits, fichiers, posts Chatter et réponses Survey pour un Account ou Contact.
components.tagline: Timeline d'activité unifiée agrégeant 16+ types de records Salesforce dans un seul flux avec filtrage avancé.
keyProps: Fenêtre jours en arrière / en avant
components.seBenefit: Tire depuis `Task`, `Event`, `EmailMessage`, `VoiceCall`, `MessagingSession`, `LiveChatTranscript`, `Order`, `Case`, `Opportunity`, `Quote`, `Contract`, `Visit`, `ContentDocumentLink`, `FeedItem`, `SurveyResponse` — et utilise les dates métier (CloseDate, EffectiveDate, StartDate) plutôt que CreatedDate.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls card title, filter panel, type/date labels, empty state, action buttons and group headings. Uses Intl for date formatting.

properties.name: excludeRelatedContacts

properties.name: sortOldestFirst

properties.name: enabledActionsCsv

properties.name: initialLimit

properties.name: defaultEnabledTypesCsv

properties.description: Comma-separated list of type keys enabled by default. Empty = all. Keys: Task, Event, Email, EmailMessage, ListEmail, Call, VoiceCall, MessagingSession, LiveChatTranscript, Cadence, Order, Case, Opportunity, Quote, Contract, Visit, File, FeedItem, SurveyResponse.

components.description: Bannière de salutation Home page avec mascotte Astro, champ de dictée vocale et bouton d'envoi. {name} est remplacé par le prénom de l'utilisateur courant. Bilingue FR / EN.
components.tagline: Header de Home page avec Astro et une barre de recherche / dictée qui transmet les questions au panneau Agentforce.
components.seBenefit: Speech-to-text via l'API navigateur — dictez une question, cliquez « Send », le texte transcrit atterrit dans votre presse-papiers. Collez-le dans le panneau Agentforce standard pour une entrée fluide en démo IA. (Pas de vraie intégration Agentforce — l'UI mime le geste.)

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls the default greeting, placeholders and speech locale.

properties.name: greetingTemplate
properties.label: Greeting text (override)
properties.description: Use {name} to inject the running user's first name. Wrap any word with double asterisks for the highlighted colour, e.g. 'Bonjour **{name}**, comment puis-je vous aider ?'. Leave empty to use the language default.

properties.name: highlightColor
properties.label: Highlight color (hex)
properties.description: Applied to the **bold** segment of the greeting. Defaults to the SE FR brand blue.

properties.name: idlePlaceholder
properties.label: Input placeholder - idle (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the language default ('Posez-moi une question…' / 'Ask me a question…').

properties.name: speechLocale
properties.label: Speech recognition locale (override)
properties.description: BCP 47 tag (e.g. fr-FR, en-US). Leave empty to use the language default.

components.description: Bandeau d'alertes configurable. Deux sources : alertes basées sur des règles évaluées contre le record courant (Record Page), et alertes statiques toujours affichées (Home / App Page). 4 sévérités, 3 variantes visuelles, 2 densités, comportement sticky-on-scroll optionnel.
components.tagline: Bandeau d'alertes configurable combinant règles déclaratives basées sur le record et bannières statiques toujours visibles.
keyProps: `rulesCsv` · règles basées sur les champs (Record Page uniquement)
components.seBenefit: Le mode rule-driven évalue un mini-DSL contre les champs du record courant (« AnnualRevenue<500000|warning|… ») — posez sur n'importe quelle record page, la bonne alerte apparaît sur le bon compte, sans code.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: rulesCsv
properties.label: Rule-driven alerts (one per line)
properties.description: Format: '<field><op><value>|<severity>|<icon>|<message>|<ctaLabel>|<ctaUrl>'. Operators: = | != | > | < | >= | <= | contains | startsWith | endsWith | isBlank | isNotBlank. Severity: info | success | warning | error. Icon and CTA fields are optional.

properties.name: staticAlertsCsv
properties.label: Static alerts (one per line)
properties.description: Always shown. Format: '<severity>|<icon>|<message>|<ctaLabel>|<ctaUrl>'.

properties.name: visualStyle
properties.label: Visual style
properties.description: 'inline' (default) renders alerts directly above the page content. 'card' wraps them in a lightning-card chrome with a title and a count pill.

properties.name: alertVariant
properties.label: Alert variant
properties.description: 'banner' (soft pastel + accent border-left), 'solid' (saturated background), 'minimal' (white background, accent bar only).

properties.name: density
properties.label: Layout density
properties.description: 'comfortable' allows wrap. 'compact' truncates the message with ellipsis.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Used only when visualStyle = card. Leave empty for the dictionary default.

properties.name: cardIcon
properties.label: Card icon
properties.description: SLDS icon name. Used only when visualStyle = card.

properties.name: stickyOnScroll
properties.label: Sticky on scroll
properties.description: When ON, the ribbon stays pinned to the top of the page on scroll.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Panneau de toggles RGPD / préférences de contact. Lit/écrit les champs opt-in/opt-out sur le record. Bilingue EN / FR.
components.tagline: Panneau de consentement RGPD par canal qui lie chaque canal à un champ booléen sur le record courant.
keyProps: Override des labels toggle / success / error
Override du titre / icône de carte
components.seBenefit: Les canaux par défaut sont mappés sur des champs Salesforce standards : `HasOptedOutOfEmail`, `DoNotCall`, `HasOptedOutOfFax` (utilisé comme placeholder pour le opt-out WhatsApp). Posez sur Contact / Lead / Account → ça marche, aucun champ custom requis.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' or 'fr'. Controls card title, toggle labels, toast messages, and default channel labels (E-mail / Téléphone / WhatsApp).

properties.name: channelsCsv
properties.label: Channels CSV (override)
properties.description: One channel per item. Format: label|fieldApiName|inverted. Inverted=true when the field stores opt-OUT. Leave empty for the language dictionary default (maps Email / Phone / WhatsApp onto Contact standard opt-out fields).

components.description: B2B / B2C - Carte Contact visuelle (avatar, détails, jusqu'à 3 jauges) avec vagues animées + résumé Einstein optionnel. Auteur original : Charly Ansel.
components.tagline: Carte Contact visuelle avec vagues animées, avatar, adresse, jauges configurables et résumé Einstein optionnel.
keyProps: Jusqu'à 3 jauges (label, champ, icône, sémantique lower/higher-better)
Image · champ URL OU upload de fichier au clic
Couleurs des vagues animées / accent thématique
Résumé Einstein via prompt · `einstein_gpt__summarizeContact` par défaut (le template livré avec la SDO, pas un vrai standard Salesforce)
components.seBenefit: Bouton « Summarize » intégré utilisant le prompt de résumé Contact livré avec la SDO — posez sur une page Contact / Case / Account et obtenez un résumé IA inline prêt à l'emploi. Cliquez sur l'avatar pour uploader une photo de contact (sans setup de schéma).

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls every visible label.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Contact').

properties.name: hideHeaderOnContact
properties.label: Hide card header on Contact page
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to remove the card title + icon when the component is placed on a Contact record page (the page already tells the user it is a contact).

properties.name: imageFieldApiName
properties.label: Image URL field API name (optional)
properties.description: Schema-safe: skipped if absent. When the contact has a value in this URL field, it wins over any uploaded file. Leave empty to rely solely on the click-to-upload File storage.

properties.name: disableImageReplace
properties.label: Disable click-to-replace image
properties.description: Off by default - clicking the avatar opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a File on the linked Contact (works on Contact, Case, Account etc. record pages). Turn ON to lock the avatar.

properties.name: customerIdFieldApiName
properties.label: Customer ID field API name
properties.description: Schema-safe: the line is skipped if the field is absent or empty.

properties.name: gauge1Label
properties.label: Gauge 1 - label
properties.description: Leave empty to hide the first gauge.

properties.name: gauge1FieldApiName
properties.label: Gauge 1 - field API name (optional)
properties.description: Numeric Contact field (0-100). When set and the record has a numeric value, it wins over the static value below. Schema-safe: skipped if absent.

properties.name: gauge1Value
properties.label: Gauge 1 - static value (optional)
properties.description: Type a number directly (0-100) to display it without needing a field. Useful for demos. Used as a fallback when the field above is empty.

properties.name: gauge1Direction
properties.label: Gauge 1 - semantics
properties.description: 'lower-better' (0=green, 100=red) for risk-style metrics. 'higher-better' (0=red, 100=green) for health / satisfaction.

properties.name: hideWaves
properties.label: Hide animated waves

properties.name: showWaves
properties.label: (deprecated) Show animated waves

properties.name: isDarkBackground
properties.label: Dark background

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.label: Background color (CSS)

properties.name: backgroundImageUrl
properties.label: Background image URL

properties.name: waveColorOne

properties.name: waveColorTwo
properties.label: Wave 2 color (override)

properties.name: disablePromptSummary

properties.name: enablePromptSummary
properties.label: (deprecated)
properties.description: Use 'Disable prompt summary' above. This property is kept for backwards compatibility only.

properties.name: promptButtonLabel
properties.label: Prompt button label (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Résumer' / 'Summarize').

properties.name: promptTemplateApiName
properties.label: Prompt template API name
properties.description: Developer name of the Einstein Prompt Template to run. Defaults to the SDO-standard contact summary template ('einstein_gpt__summarizeContact').

properties.name: promptInputApiName
properties.label: Prompt template input API name
properties.description: Typically 'Input:Contact'.

properties.name: autoPromptOnLoad
properties.label: Run prompt automatically on load
properties.description: When on and the prompt is enabled, the summary fires as soon as the component loads - no button click required.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Indicateur' / 'Metric').

properties.name: hideCardTitle
properties.label: Hide the card wrapper
properties.description: Off by default - the tile is wrapped in a lightning-card with a title. Turn on to render the bare tile (no card header) for dense dashboards.

properties.name: metricLabel
properties.label: Metric label (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('CA (12 mois)' / 'Revenue (12 mo.)').

properties.name: currentValueDisplay
properties.label: Headline value (text override)
properties.description: Large value shown at the top of the tile. Wins over the numeric currentValue when set. Leave empty for the language default.

properties.name: currentValue
properties.label: Headline value (numeric, optional)
properties.description: Numeric value used to auto-format the headline via Intl.NumberFormat (compact currency). Ignored when 'Headline value (text override)' is set.

properties.name: currencyCode
properties.label: Currency ISO code
properties.description: Used by the numeric formatter. ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP...).

properties.name: chartStyle
properties.label: Chart style
properties.description: 'line' (curve only), 'area' (curve + filled area below), 'bar' (vertical bars), 'mini-donut' (radial gauge from currentValue / targetValue).

properties.name: seriesJson
properties.label: Series points - JSON array
properties.description: Array of numbers. 12 points = one per month. Leave empty for a sample up-trend curve. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

properties.name: secondarySeriesJson
properties.label: Secondary series - JSON array (optional)
properties.description: Optional comparison series (e.g. forecast, target run-rate). Drawn as a dashed line. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

properties.name: targetValue
properties.label: Target value (optional)
properties.description: When set, draws a horizontal dashed line at this Y on line/area/bar charts. Used as the denominator for the mini-donut variant.

properties.name: showTargetLabel
properties.label: Show target label chip
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to display a 'Target XX €' chip next to the metric label.

properties.name: scalingMode
properties.label: Y-axis scaling
properties.description: 'auto' (data min/max), 'from-zero' (forces Y origin to 0), 'fixed' (uses yMin / yMax below).

properties.name: accentColor
properties.label: Accent color (hex)
properties.description: Color of the primary chart series. Defaults to SE FR brand blue.

properties.name: donutTrack
properties.label: Mini-donut track color (hex)
properties.description: Background ring color. Used only when chartStyle = mini-donut.

properties.name: height
properties.label: Chart height (px)
properties.description: Internal viewBox height. CSS scales the SVG to fit the column width.

properties.name: width
properties.label: Chart width override (px)
properties.description: 0 = auto (default ~600px viewBox). Set a fixed value for very narrow tiles.

properties.name: trendDisplay
properties.label: Trend badge text
properties.description: Sign drives the color: a leading '+' (or no sign on a non-zero number) is green, '-' is red, '0%' is grey.

properties.name: enableTooltip
properties.label: Enable hover tooltip
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to show value-on-point on hover (line / area / bar).

properties.name: trendPositive
properties.label: (deprecated) Trend is positive
properties.description: No longer used - the color is auto-derived from the sign of trendDisplay.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Vue timeline du jour pour une colonne sidebar. Auto-trim des heures vides, gestion des events qui se chevauchent côte à côte, ligne « now » en live, badge in-N-min, bouton Join pour les URLs de visio classiques, et liste Upcoming courte.
components.tagline: Calendrier du jour en timeline verticale compacte qui tient dans une colonne sidebar, avec gestion des chevauchements style Google Calendar.
components.seBenefit: Utile à la fois en Field Sales (rendez-vous du jour) et comme widget « agenda » transversal sur la Home Page de n'importe quel persona.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls all built-in UI strings (headings, buttons, badges). Explicit values set on cardTitle / emptyStateMessage still override the dictionary.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘My Day’ / ‘Ma journée’).

properties.name: startHour
properties.label: Start hour (0-23)
properties.description: Earliest hour shown when auto-trim is off or when auto-trim can't narrow further.

properties.name: endHour
properties.label: End hour (0-23)
properties.description: Latest hour shown (same rule as start hour).

properties.name: disableAutoTrim
properties.label: Disable auto-trim
properties.description: Auto-trim is ON by default - the timeline is bounded to [first event − padding, last event + padding] (clamped between Start and End hour). Turn this on to always render the full Start→End hour window.

properties.name: autoTrimPaddingMin
properties.label: Auto-trim padding (minutes)
properties.description: Empty-hour margin kept before the first event and after the last event when auto-trim is on. Set to 0 to crop exactly to the events.

properties.name: daysAhead
properties.label: Days ahead to query
properties.description: Today counts as 1. Used to populate the Upcoming list.

properties.name: typeColorsCsv
properties.label: Type colors (Type|#hex, comma-separated)
properties.description: Matched against Event.Type (case-insensitive). 'Other' is the fallback.

properties.name: typesFilterCsv
properties.label: Event types to keep (comma-separated, optional)
properties.description: Whitelist of Event.Type values to show. Leave empty to include every type. Acts as a static filter - the in-UI toggles mute types on top of this.

properties.name: hideTypeToggles
properties.label: Hide clickable type toggles
properties.description: Off by default - chips are shown. Turn on to hide the one-chip-per-Event.Type filter strip that lets the user mute/unmute each 'calendar' in the timeline.

properties.name: hideNowLine
properties.label: Hide the 'now' line
properties.description: Off by default - the red line is shown.

properties.name: hideJoinButton
properties.label: Hide the auto-detected Join button
properties.description: Off by default - scans Event Location and Description for a Zoom / Teams / Meet / WebEx URL and shows a Join button when found.

properties.name: emptyStateMessage
properties.label: Empty-state message (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default.

properties.name: emptyStateMessage

components.description: Panneau IA configurable qui exécute des Salesforce Prompt Templates via Invocable Actions. Posez sur n'importe quelle page, le SE choisit les prompts à exposer. Le contexte record est auto-injecté, les prompts qui demandent des inputs affichent un petit formulaire. Les réponses HTML sont rendues avec le formatage.
components.tagline: Panneau IA configurable qui exécute des Salesforce Prompt Templates via Invocable Actions, avec contexte record auto-injecté.
keyProps: `promptsJson` · catalogue (apiName, label, icon, objects[], userInputs[], extraInputs)
Filtrage automatique par type de record (Account → résumé Account, Home → free-text)
Détection auto HTML / Markdown · hauteur dynamique
components.seBenefit: Le catalogue par défaut couvre les résumés Account / Contact / Opportunity / Lead / Case + free-text Summarize/Refine — posez sur n'importe quelle record page, le bon prompt apparaît automatiquement. Save as Note attache la sortie IA au record en un clic.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Assistant IA' / 'AI Assistant').

properties.name: namedCredential
properties.label: Named Credential
properties.description: Named Credential routing the Apex callout to the org's REST API. Default 'Agentforce_API'. Despite the legacy name, it's used for any /services/data/... callout — Prompt Templates, Agent API, etc. Setup → Named Credentials in your org.

properties.name: promptsJson
properties.label: Prompts catalogue (JSON)
properties.description: JSON array. Each entry: { apiName, label, icon, objects:['Account',...], recordInputName:'Input:Account', userInputs:[{name,label,type,required,options}] }. 'objects' filters by host record type — empty list = always show. Leave the prop empty to use the default catalogue (Account/Contact/Deal/Lead/Case summaries + free-text Summarize/Refine).

properties.name: autoRunFirstPrompt
properties.label: Auto-run first prompt on load
properties.description: When ON, the first applicable prompt runs automatically as soon as the page loads. Skips silently if any required user input is empty.

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.label: Maximum component height (px)
properties.description: 0 (default) = no cap, the component grows with the AI response. Set a number (e.g. 600) to cap the vertical footprint and enable scroll inside the component when the response is very long.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Panneau highlights custom avec image ronde et champs / actions configurables. Fonctionne sur Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead, Order, Contract, Quote — peut afficher le record courant ou son parent Account (propriété recordSource).
components.tagline: Panneau highlights custom avec image ronde, champs clés et boutons d'action, fonctionnel sur 8 objets standards.
components.seBenefit: Cliquez sur l'avatar pour uploader / remplacer l'image instantanément — sans static resource, sans hosting public d'URL, sans champ custom. L'image est sauvegardée comme un File sur le record.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls button labels (Edit / Modifier, View Account Hierarchy / Voir la hiérarchie) and empty-state messages.

properties.name: recordSource
properties.label: Record source
properties.description: current = show the record on the current page. parent = show the linked Account (Contact/Opportunity/Case/Order/Contract/Quote/Lead) or the Parent Account (when on an Account page).

properties.name: accountFieldsList
properties.label: Account - fields to display (comma-separated)
properties.description: Used when the displayed record is an Account.

properties.name: contactFieldsList
properties.label: Contact - fields to display (comma-separated)
properties.description: Used when the displayed record is a Contact.

properties.name: imageFieldApiName
properties.label: Image URL field API name (optional)
properties.description: Optional. API name of a text/URL field on the current object holding an image URL (e.g. a custom ImageURL__c). If present, takes priority over the File-based image. Leave empty to rely on the built-in File storage - the component uploads the replacement as a standard File on the record, no custom schema required.

properties.name: imageSize
properties.label: Image size (px)
properties.description: Diameter of the round image in pixels. Also sets the fallback icon circle size.

properties.name: disableImageReplace
properties.label: Disable click-to-replace image
properties.description: Off by default - clicking the image opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a standard File on the record. Turn ON to restore the legacy 'open image full size' behavior.

properties.name: maxQuickActions

properties.name: quickActionsCsv
properties.label: Quick actions override (API names, comma-separated)
properties.description: Optional. Forces a specific list instead of the page-layout default. Example: 'Edit,SendEmail'. Leave empty to use the layout.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Carte verticale qui affiche un record lié (l'Account d'un Contact/Case/Opp, ou le Contact principal d'un Account). Choisit la contrepartie automatiquement à partir du type de record courant. Bilingue EN / FR. Valeurs par défaut industry-agnostic.

properties.name: target

properties.name: cardIcon

properties.description: Leave empty for sensible defaults. Contact default: 'Title,Department,Email,Phone,MobilePhone'. Account default: 'Industry,Type,Phone,Website,AnnualRevenue,NumberOfEmployees'. Fields unknown to the target are silently skipped.

properties.name: contactImageFieldApiName

properties.description: URL field on Contact used as the image source when the displayed target is Contact. Schema-safe: skipped if the field is absent. Falls back to a File attached to the contact when empty.

properties.name: accountImageFieldApiName

properties.description: Optional URL field on Account. Empty by default - the card uses the File attached to the account as the image source.

properties.name: disableImageReplace

components.description: Sales / Field Sales - Vue carte du territoire : Accounts géolocalisés via leur Billing Address, code couleur par pipeline ouvert, filtres latéraux (Owner, RecordType, fourchette de montant ouvert, Stages, statut Case, Type, Industry + recherche par nom), tuiles KPI et export CSV.

properties.name: language

properties.name: cardTitle

properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default.

properties.name: limitCount
properties.label: Max accounts
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-200).

properties.name: defaultOwnerScope
properties.label: Default owner scope
properties.description: 'mine' = accounts owned by the running user (with auto-fallback to all when empty). 'all' = every owner.

properties.name: defaultRecordType
properties.label: Default RecordType (developer name)
properties.description: Optional. Pre-selects an Account RecordType filter (developer name). Leave empty to show all types.

properties.name: defaultStagesCsv
properties.label: Default opportunity stages (CSV)
properties.description: Optional. Pre-selects opportunity stages used to compute open-amount KPIs. Empty = all open opportunities.

properties.name: filterFieldAApiName
properties.label: Filter field A (API name)
properties.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Type). Set to a custom field if useful.

properties.name: filterFieldBApiName
properties.label: Filter field B (API name)
properties.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Industry). Set to a custom field if useful.

properties.name: currencyCode
properties.label: Currency ISO code
properties.description: ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP...).

properties.name: zoomLevel
properties.label: Default zoom level
properties.description: lightning-map zoom level (1=world, 13=neighborhood).

properties.name: defaultCenterLatitude
properties.label: Default center - latitude
properties.description: Initial map center latitude. Defaults to France (46.7). Override for other regions.

properties.name: defaultCenterLongitude
properties.label: Default center - longitude
properties.description: Initial map center longitude. Defaults to France (2.5).

properties.name: mapHeight
properties.label: Map height (px)
properties.description: Fixed height of the map + list area. The list scrolls independently inside this height.

properties.name: mapWidthRatio
properties.label: Map / list ratio
properties.description: Horizontal split ratio between the map (left) and the account list (right). Range 0.4 - 0.85. Default 0.66 = map ~ 2/3, list ~ 1/3.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Timeline horizontale multi-phases (parcours client / étapes projet). Les phases sont configurées en JSON avec labels, dates cibles et flags done. Un marqueur vertical « Today » indique la position actuelle.
components.tagline: Timeline horizontale multi-phases avec axe de dates, marqueur « Today » et état done / pending par phase.
components.seBenefit: Visualise un parcours ou un état de processus sans nécessiter d'objets custom ni de flows — saisissez les phases directement dans App Builder.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title and the default phases when Phases JSON is empty.

properties.name: scope
properties.label: Default phases scope
properties.description: Seeds the default phases depending on where the component is used. 'record' = customer / deal cycle (Prospection → Découverte → Démo → Proposition → Closing). 'home' = global fiscal milestones (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 kick-off / ramp-up / expansion / year-end). Override with Phases JSON below to customise fully.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('Parcours' / 'Journey').

properties.name: phasesJson
properties.label: Phases - JSON array (override)
properties.description: Array of objects. Each item: { label, date (YYYY-MM-DD), done (boolean) }. Leave empty for the scope + language default.

properties.name: hideTodayMarker
properties.label: Hide 'Today' marker
properties.description: Off by default - the vertical dotted line showing today's position is displayed.

components.seBenefit: Speech-to-text via l'API navigateur `SpeechRecognition` — aucune dépendance Einstein ni service externe. Démontrable sur n'importe quelle org tant que le navigateur est Chrome.
